shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo "-----" && ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && cat AGENTS.md && find .agents -type f | head -100

sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo "----- grep -----" && rg -n -C 3 -i 'navigation|@gravity-ui/table|app shell|data grid|dnd|drag' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -120
cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md

cat index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore && find src -type f | xargs -I{} sh -c 'echo "=== {}"; cat {}' && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"' && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls __agent_eval__

sed -n 452,480p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && sed -n 367,385p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | grep '"version"' && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | head -5 && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | wc -l
npm view @gravity-ui/table version peerDependencies --json 2>&1 | head -40; npm view @gravity-ui/navigation version peerDependencies --json 2>&1 | head -40

npm install @gravity-ui/table @gravity-ui/navigation @dnd-kit/core @dnd-kit/sortable @dnd-kit/utilities lodash @bem-react/classname 2>&1 | tail -15 && npm install -D @types/lodash 2>&1 | tail -3 && grep -E '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/package.json node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json node_modules/@dnd-kit/core/package.json node_modules/@dnd-kit/sortable/package.json node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/ node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/ && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/dist/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/dist/docs 2>&1
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs/INDEX.md && ls -R node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs | head -60

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md && ls -R node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs | head -60 && rg -n -C 3 -i 'required setup|styles.css|import' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md | head -60
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md | head -220

rg -n -C 2 -i 'styles|css|exports' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/package.json | head -40; rg -n -i 'styles.css|import .*css' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json | head; echo "--- BaseTable props ---"; rg -n -C 1 -i 'getGroupTitle|renderGroupHeader|groupHeader|rowClassName|onRowClick|stickyHeader|className' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs/components/BaseTable.md | head -80

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | grep -E '^(House|Persons|Person|Gear|ShoppingCart|Cart|Box|Bag|ChartBar|LayoutHeaderCells|ListUl|Receipt|CreditCard|Magnifier|Bars|Clock|CircleCheck|CircleXmark|ArrowRight|Ghost|ArrowsRotateLeft|Xmark|Check|TrashBin|Funnel|Layers|LayoutCells|Grip|Cube|Cubes|Truck|Moon|Sun|Bell|Plus|FolderTree)\.d\.ts$' | tr '\n' ' '

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/ && rg -n 'export' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -60 && rg -n -A 40 'export interface BaseTableProps|export type BaseTableProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.d.ts | head -120

echo "=== Table.d.ts ===" && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/Table/Table.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/Table/types.d.ts && echo "=== css imports ===" && rg -n "\.css'" node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/Table/Table.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.js 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/ | head -30; echo "=== group header default ===" && rg -n -B2 -A6 'getIsGroupHeaderRow' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/BaseRow.js | head -60; echo "=== useRowSelectionFixedHandler ===" && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/hooks/useRowSelectionFixedHandler/useRowSelectionFixedHandler.d.ts 2>/dev/null || find node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/hooks -name '*FixedHandler*' -exec cat {} \;; echo "=== useTable ===" && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/hooks/useTable/useTable.d.ts; echo "=== types/base ===" && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/types/base.d.ts | head -80

echo "=== AsideHeader props ===" && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -150; echo "=== MenuItem types ===" && rg -n -A 40 'export interface MenuItem\b|export type MenuItem\b' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/types.d.ts | head -80; echo "=== Logo ===" && rg -n -A 25 'export interface LogoProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/Logo/Logo.d.ts | head -40; echo "=== navigation index exports ===" && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -40; echo "=== AsideHeader css ===" && rg -ln "\.css" node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/*.js | head -3

rg -n -A 12 'headerDecoration|renderContent|customBackground|hideCollapseButton|expandTitle' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md | sed -n 1,200p | rg -n '^\d+[-:]\| ' | head -60; echo "=== Label/Text in uikit ==="; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Label/Label.d.ts | head -60

echo "=== BaseRow group default ===" && rg -n -B3 -A12 'getIsGroupHeaderRow' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/hooks/*.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/utils/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -80; echo "=== nav types ===" && find node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm -maxdepth 3 -name 'types.d.ts' | head && rg -n -A 30 'export interface MenuItem ' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -60; echo "=== Logo ===" && rg -n -B2 -A 30 'export interface LogoProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -50; echo "=== RenderContentType ===" && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/Content/Content.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseGroupHeader/BaseGroupHeader.js | head -40; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseGroupHeader/BaseGroupHeader.d.ts; echo "=== dragHandle/selection consts ==="; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/constants/selectionColumn.js 2>/dev/null | head -30; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/constants/; echo "=== uikit components check ==="; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ | grep -E '^(Switch|Checkbox|Text|Label|Flex|Box|Button|Icon|Card|Select|TextInput|Divider|Avatar|Tooltip|Skeleton)$' | tr '\n' ' '; echo; rg -n 'size\?|view\?' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head; rg -n -A3 'export interface TextInputProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts | head; rg -n "startContent|placeholder|hasClear" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/types.d.ts | head

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts; rg -n -A3 'export interface ControlProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts; rg -n 'onUpdate|onChange|content\?|checked\?' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head; rg -n "type CardView|type CardSize|type CardType|type CardTheme" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts; rg -n "color\?|variant\?|ellipsis\?|whiteSpace\?" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; rg -n "TEXT_COLORS|type TextColor" -A 3 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head -12; rg -n "direction\?|gap\?|alignItems\?|justifyContent\?|wrap\?|grow\?|width\?" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -12
ls src/data && wc -l src/data/orders.ts

rg -n 'getIsPinned|getLeftVisibleLeafColumns|getCenterVisibleLeafColumns' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseTable/*.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/utils/*.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseHeaderRow/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -8; echo "=== aside css height ==="; rg -o 'gn-aside-header\{[^}]*\}|gn-aside-header__pane-container\{[^}]*\}|gn-aside-header__content\{[^}]*\}' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css | head -5; rg -n -o '\.gn-aside-header__content[^{]*\{[^}]*\}' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css | head -3; echo "=== table css vars ==="; rg -o '\-\-gt-table-[a-z-]+' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/Table/Table.css | sort -u | head -20
npx tsc --noEmit; echo "tsc exit: $?"; npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -12

rg -n -o 'gn-aside-header[a-z_-]*\{[^}]*(height|min-height)[^}]*\}' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/*/*.css 2>/dev/null | head -8; echo "=== group header css ==="; rg -n -o '\.gt-group-header[^{]*\{[^}]*\}' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseGroupHeader/BaseGroupHeader.css | head -4; rg -n -o 'g-table__group-header[^{]*\{[^}]*\}' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/Table/Table.css | head -4

rg -n -i 'height' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css | head -10; rg -n -i 'gn-page-layout|min-height|height' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/PageLayout/*.css 2>/dev/null | head -10; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/ | head -30

rg -n -i 'ResizeObserver|useLayoutEffect|getBoundingClientRect|clientHeight' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/CompositeBar/CompositeBar.js 2>/dev/null | head -5; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/ | rg -i 'composite|menu' ; rg -ln 'menu-items' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/components/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -3
rm -f src/smoke.test.tsx vitest.smoke.config.ts /tmp/smoke.html && rm -rf dist && git status --short && cat package.json

npm uninstall @dnd-kit/utilities 2>&1 | tail -2 && npx tsc --noEmit && echo "tsc ok" && rg -n -i 'useEffect|useLayoutEffect|ResizeObserver|mounted|isClient' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/components/FirstPanel.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/CompositeBar/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -6
